text:
sarah: Uploading pen-test artifacts for the Acme POC. Link below — need triage, vuln scan diffs, and remediation timeline by EOD Wed for vendor risk team. Owners? cc @mike @alex
S3: https://s3.redwood.example/acme/pt-1715223344.zip

infra-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme/1715223344.zip (size 42MB). Signed URL expires in 7d.

mike: Received. Please attach checksums and confirm whether credentials/tokens were present in any logs. Also: was the scanner run authenticated or unauthenticated?

sarah: Scanner was authenticated via a read-only service account. No customer PII expected. Uploaded `scan-diffs/` and `full-report.pdf`. Checksums below.

alex: quick checksums:
```
sha256 9f1b2a7c8e...  acme-report.pdf
sha256 e3c4d5f6a1...  scan-diffs.tar.gz
sha256 4a7b8c9d0e...  repro-scripts.tar.gz
```
Repro steps in repro/README.md. I see two medium findings: EFS mount egress and outdated nginx package.

jenna: Repro'd both issues locally. nginx vuln (CVE-2024-XXXX) fixed by bump to 1.22.1 — patch PR linked. EFS egress: STS token rotation allowed broader range; recommend lock down SG + explicit NAT egress list.

alex: Proposed remediation timeline:
- nginx patch -> staging deploy Mon 10:00-12:00 (owner: alex)
- EFS egress rule change -> infra config Tue 16:00 (owner: infra)
- verify scan -> Wed 09:00
I'll open PRs and infra tickets.

mike: I'll prepare a one-pager for vendor risk confirming no creds leaked and listing acceptance criteria. Can we get that by Tue noon?

sarah: Approved. Mike, please draft Tue noon. Alex, confirm staging window? I'll update ACME.

alex: Confirmed. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/123 — requires 2-hr deploy slot Mon 10-12. Rollback steps included in PR.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4523 (egress rule change). ETA: 2024-05-14T16:00Z.

mike: Adding vuln tracker IDs and CVSS to the bundle. Acceptance checks for vendor risk: verified scan with no medium/high, config diff for SG changes, nginx >=1.22.1.

sarah: TL;DR timeline — nginx patch Mon, egress Tue, verify Wed, one-pager Tue noon. :thumbsup:

alex: Assigning tasks in Jira and tagging jenna for verification. Will post ticket links once created.
